chapter.verse: Tua ciangin vanmi khat vantung pan hong kumsuk ka mu a, a khut ah leihawmpi honna tawhtang leh sikkol golpi khat tawi hi.
Tua vanmi in dawimangpa leh Satan zong ahi, tua tanglai gulpi, gulpi samnei pen mankipin kum tulkhat sung khihcip hi.
Leihawmpi sungah lawnsukin tawhkalh a, ama' tungah ciaptehna gipa belh hi. Kum tulkhat a cin mateng minamte a khem theih nawnloh nading ahi hi. Tua khitzawh tawmvei sung amah kikhahkhia ding hi.

Tua ciangin kumpi-tokhomte ka mu a, tua tunga a tute pen thukhen theihna thu a ki-apte ahi uh hi. Jesu' thu teci panna hang leh Pasian' thu hangin ngawngtan a thuakte' nunna khate zong ka mu hi. Amaute pen sapi leh ama' milim a biak loh manun a tal tung uh leh a khut tung uhah sapi ciaptehna lim a nei lote ahi uh hi. Amaute hong hingkik uh a, kum tulkhat sung Khris tawh ukkhawm uh hi.
A omlai misi dang teng ahihleh kum tulkhat a bei mateng hingkik lo uh hi. Hih pen Thawhkik Khatna ahi hi.

Thawhkik khatna sunga kihelkha teng thuphangah leh a siangtho ahi uh hi. Sih nihna in tua bang mite' tungah uktheihna thu nei lo hi. Amaute Pasian leh Khris' siampite hiding uh a, kum tulkhat sung Khris tawh ukkhawm ding hi.
Kum tulkhat a cin ciangin a thong sungpan Satan kikhahkhia ding a,
leitung kiu lite-a om minamte ahi Gog leh Magog a khem dingin hong kuankhia ding a, galsimpih dingin tuate kaikhawm ding hi. A phazah vekpi pen tuipi sehnel bang ahi hi.
Leitung a dung a vai ah amaute kuanto uh a, mi siangthote' giahphual leh it-huai khuapi uumcih uh hi. Ahih hangin vantung pan mei kiasukin amaute mei in kangtum hi.
Amau a khem dawimangpa zong sapi leh kamsang zuaupa a omna mun, kaat meili sungah kilawnsuk a, a sun a zan cilo, a tawntung a tawntungin gawt a thuak ding uh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi-tokhom kang a lianpi khat leh a tunga a tupa ka mu hi. Ama' mai panin leitung leh vantung mang vatin amau' ading mun om lo hi.

Tua ciangin misite a neu a lian, kumpi-tokhom mai-ah a din uh ka mu a, laibute zong zalsa-in om hi. Laibu dang khat ahi, nuntakna laibu zong zalsa-in om hi. Misite a sepsa uh tawh kizui-in laibute sunga kigelh thute tawh thu kikhen hi.
Tua ciangin tuipi in ama' sunga om misite pusuah a, Sihna leh Leinuai in zong amau' sunga om misite pusuah uh hi. Tua mite khat ciat amau' sepsa tek tawh kizui-in thu kikhen hi.
Tua ciangin meili sungah Sihna leh Leinuai kilawnsuk hi. Hih pen sih nihna meili ahi hi.
Mi khatpeuh nuntakna laibu sungah a min a kimuh keileh meili sungah a kilawnsuk ahi hi.
